_comment: Hydra tool definitions. Schema assumes OpenAI-style function tools (name + JSON-schema parameters). Adjust the envelope to match Hydra's exact tool-calling format once confirmed (see docs/HYDRA_CONTRACT.md §4). The orchestrator executes these client-side and returns a tool.result.

function.name: point_at
function.description: Point the on-screen cursor at a UI element so the user can see exactly what you mean. Use the element's exact label from the latest ON SCREEN NOW context.

label.description: Exact label of the element to point at, e.g. 'Export button'.

function.name: highlight
function.description: Draw an attention ring around a UI element the user should focus on. Same label space as point_at.

function.name: look
function.description: Request a fresh read of the screen. Call this when the ON SCREEN NOW context is empty, stale, or the user just changed what's visible. Returns the updated element list.

function.name: book_flight
function.description: [Phase 5 — real-world action via MCP] Search/book a flight. Only call after the user explicitly asks and you've confirmed origin, destination, date, and that they accept the fare out loud. Returns whatever the booking MCP server reports; never fabricate a result.

return_date.description: ISO date YYYY-MM-DD, omit for one-way.

confirm.description: true = actually book; false = search only.
